description: Screen a person or organization name against the current OFAC SDN, OFAC Consolidated Non-SDN, and EU financial sanctions datasets. Returns potential fuzzy matches with confidence scores, per-list provenance (list versions, source URLs, SHA-256 digests), and a cryptographic EIP-712 attestation sealing the exact response issued. Informational screening signal only — not a legal determination, sanctions certification, compliance clearance, or legal advice. Free during launch. For production volume, the same screening core is available as a paid x402 API: POST https://api-1-screening.agent-tollbooth.workers.dev/screen ($0.02 USDC/call on Base, no account or API key needed).

dob.description: Date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD (optional; must be a real past date).

name.description: Full name of the person or organization to screen (2-200 characters).
